title: Jane and Pip's Sweet Quest

subtitle.text: Jane and Pip are at Gran's gate.
"Have fun with Gran!" Mom says.
Mom and Dad drive off.
Gran and the kids wave.
Then they go inside.
"What can we do?" Jane asks.
Gran gets an old box.
"You can play Sweet Land.
It's a fun game."
Pip smiles. "A candy game!"
Gran goes to make lunch.
"Set up the game," Jane says.
"Don't tell me what to do," Pip says.
Pip takes out a map.
"I want the red dot," Jane says.
But Pip grabs it fast.
Jane is mad. "That's not nice!"
Pip puts the red dot on a tile.
Jane gets a white dot.
Then she picks up the dice.
"I will go," Jane says.
But Pip grabs the dice.
"I got a six!" he says.
"Stop that!" Jane says.
Pip slides his dot and grins.
Jane's face goes red. "You went ten tiles!
You can't do that!"
"The game has rules," Jane says.
"It was just a joke," Pip says.
Jane puts Pip's dot back.
"Now I will go," Jane says.
Pip pokes Jane.
"Stop that!" she says.
But Pip pokes her on the nose. "Bop!"
"Gran!" Jane runs to the stove.
Pip goes too.
"Pip is rude!" Jane says.
"Jane tells me what to do," Pip says.
"You broke the rules!" Jane says.
"Pip, don't play jokes on Jane," Gran says.
"And Jane, don't boss Pip."
They nod. "Sorry, Gran."
Jane and Pip go back to the game.
Pip hums a tune.
"Your tune is not cute," Jane says.
"Yes, it is," Pip says. "Just like me!"
He hums again.
"Ugh!" Jane takes the dice. "Five."
She puts her dot on a rose tile.
A puff of smoke rises from the tile.
Then there is a white flash.
"What is that?" Jane says.
Pip gasps. "It's a sprite!"
The sprite's wand shines.
"Who are you?" Pip asks.
"My name is June," the sprite says.
"I come from Sweet Land."
"Wow!" Pip grins.
But Jane does not. "Is this a joke?"
"Sweet Land is just a game."
Pip taps Jane. "That's not nice."
"No, it's not a joke," June says.
"Sweet Land is my home."
"What do you want?" Jane asks.
"Jane, that's rude!" Pip says.
June takes out a note.
"This is for you," she says.
"It's from the queen."
June waves her wand. [i@Zap!@i]
The note gets big.
The kids look at it.
[i@To Jane and Pip,@i]
[i@The Duke of Yuck has a bad plan.@i]
[i@He wants to take over Sweet Land.@i]
[i@You must help us.@i]
From Queen Sweet
Pip hops up and down. "How fun!"
"This is fake," Jane says.
June huffs. "It's not fake.
You are the prince and the princess!
You must help the queen!"
Pip claps. "I'm a prince!"
"No," Jane says. "And I'm not a princess."
"Yes, you are, Princess Jane," June says.
"You must come with me."
Jane blinks. "What?"
"I will explain," June says.
"Sweet Land has a candy train."
Pip licks his lips. "Yum!"
"The Duke of Yuck hates candy," June says.
"One day he broke the rails.
Then he stole the candy from the train."
Pip gasps as June goes on.
"So the queen put him in jail."
"Yay!" Pip says.
"But the duke got away!" June says.
"He just broke out of jail.
You can help us stop his plan."
"We can't stay here," Pip says.
"We have to help!"
"It's just a game, Pip," Jane says.
"It may be a game," Pip says.
"But I still want to play!"
Pip grabs Jane's hand.
June raises her wand.
"I will take you all the way there."
But Jane steps back.
"Wait! I still think this is fake."
"This is all a dream," Jane says.
"Sweet Land is not real."
"You're not fun, Jane," Pip says.
June looks sad. "I must go back now.
I need to meet with the queen.
I will tell her you will not help."
June lands on a cake on the map.
She waves her wand. [i@Zap!@i]
"Where did she go?" Pip asks.
Just then Gran says, "It's time to eat!"
Gran and the kids eat a meal.
"Sweet Land is fun," Pip says.
"We met a sprite who needs our help."
"Oh?" Gran says.
"It's just a game, Pip," Jane says.
"It's real!" Pip says.
Gran pats Jane on the knee. "Be nice."
"Pip," Gran says. "Jane ate her peas.
You ate only meat."
"Green peas." Pip makes a face. "Yuck!"
"If you eat them . . . ," Gran says.
"I will give you a sweet treat."
Jane blinks when she sees Gran's cake.
"It looks like the cake from the game."
Pip eats his slice of cake.
Jane takes her last bite.
"It's time to clean," Gran says.
"One of you can sweep.
One of you may wipe the tray."
Pip pokes Jane. "Jane will sweep."
"No! Pip will sweep," Jane says.
"You two need to get along," Gran says.
"Be sweet and not mean."
Pip wipes the tray, and Jane sweeps.
"I will get the mail," Gran says.
Jane goes to look at the game.
"Pip," Jane says. "Come see this."
"That cake looks like Gran's cake," Pip says.
The kids check all over the map.
"What are those spots?" Jane asks.
"The game does not look the same now."
"The spots look like gray slime," Pip says.
"I bet the Duke of Yuck made them.
He needs to go back to jail!"
"It's not a dream," Jane says.
"Sweet Land is real!"
"And the queen needs our help," Pip says.
"We cannot wait!"
"How do we find June?" Pip asks.
Jane sticks her dot on the rose tile.
"I did this last time," she says.
But the sprite does not come.
Pip sighs. "Now what?"
Jane tries again.
"You did not do it right!" Pip cries.
Jane makes a face.
"I bet you can't do it."
Gran comes in. "Kids, don't fight."
"Sorry, Gran," Pip says.
Jane looks down. "Me too."
Just then Gran sways.
"Gran, are you all right?" Jane asks.
"I feel odd," Gran replies.
"I need to lie down."
Gran goes to take a nap.
"We need to find June," Pip says.
Jane grabs the map. "I will find her."
"Stop! You had two tries," Pip says.
"Let me do it now."
He grabs the map too.
"Let go! You will rip it!" Jane cries.
[i@Bam!@i] There's a bright flash of light.
Pip jumps. "What a fright!"
Then June flies out!
"June!" Pip says. "You came back!"
June sobs and does not reply.
Jane looks shy. "Don't cry, June.
I'm sorry I was rude.
I want to help Sweet Land now."
"It's too late," June says sadly.
"Why?" Pip rubs his chin.
"The duke got the queen," June says.
"He put a spell on her.
Now she sleeps and sleeps."
Pip gasps. "The duke is bad!"
"Sweet Land is unhappy now," June says.
"The duke made sticky slime spots all over.
He wants to make Sweet Land yucky."
"We will catch him!" Pip says.
"We will put him in chains!"
Jane makes a fist. "We have to try."
"It will not be easy," June says.
Just then the game shakes.
A slime hand pops out and grabs June.
"June!" the kids cry.
The slime tugs her back to the game.
June can't get free.
"I am weak when the queen sleeps.
This is all I can do for you."
She waves her wand at the kids. [i@Zap!@i]
"The slime hand got June!" Pip cries.
A flash of light shines from the game.
It sucks in the kids.
"Ahh!" they cry.
Then the bright light fades.
The kids drop from the sky.
[i@Splat!@i] They land in a sticky spot.
"Oh no! It's slime!" Jane says.
Pip checks the sticky stuff. "No, it's jelly.
Sweet Land [i@is@i] sweet.
But . . . where is June?"
Jane rubs her chin.
"Let's try to find her."
The kids walk in long grass.
"This grass looks like candy," Pip says.
"And the hills look like pies."
He picks some grass and chomps on it.
"Yummy!"
"Yuck." Jane makes a face.
Pip grins. "Try it."
"No, thanks," Jane says.
"I don't see slime here.
Was June right?"
"I don't think she lied," Pip says.
Just then he stops and bends down.
Jane sighs. "Don't eat the grass."
"I'm not," Pip says. "I see June's wand!"
Jane gasps. "Why is it there?"
Pip grabs the wand. "June must be close."
The kids spot a road.
"It's the road from the game," Jane says.
Pip jumps onto a big tile. "Let's go!"
The kids follow the road past cupcake trees.
They come to a wide stream.
"The stream looks like mud," Jane says.
Pip grins. "I think it's . . . cocoa!"
"How can we cross?" Jane asks.
"I see a boat over there," Pip says.
"Let's take that."
The kids get in the boat.
"Row," Jane says.
Pip groans. "You can row too."
Jane sighs. "Fine."
The kids row the boat.
Jane looks in the stream. "Oh no!"
Gray spots float on top of the cocoa.
The spots grow into big shapes.
Pip shakes with fright. "Slime monsters!"
One grabs Jane's elbow.
[i@Fwip! Fwip!@i] Arrows fly.
The arrows hit the monsters.
The monsters groan and fade away.
"Who shot those arrows?" Jane asks.
"Look!" Pip says.
"There's a knight with a bow!"
"It's true," Jane says. "There [i@is@i] slime here."
"I knew it," Pip says. "June didn't lie!"
The kids wave to the knight.
Just then—[i@splash!@i]
New slime monsters pop up.
A few grab the boat.
Pip tries to slap them away.
"Ew! They are sticky like glue."
"I will rescue you," the knight yells.
He blows a big blue gum bubble.
It zips to the kids.
"Grab the bubble!" he says.
The kids grab onto the bubble.
It flies them to the knight.
"Phew! We're safe!" Jane says.
Pip smiles. "Thank you!"
The knight kneels. "Princess Jane, Prince Pip.
I am Blue Ralph the Bubble Gum Knight."
"Do you know June?" Jane asks.
"Yes. She went to find you," Ralph says.
"A slime hand got her!" Pip says.
Ralph gasps. "This is bad news."
"We think she is here now," Jane says.
"We have a clue."
Jane shows Ralph the wand.
Ralph looks upset. "The duke got June too!"
"The duke got June?" Pip cries.
"This is bad news," Jane says.
Blue Ralph nods. "It seems true.
Now you must rescue June and the queen."
He shows the kids where the road is.
"Go to the top of Ice Cream Hill.
Then follow the road to the castle."
"Will you come?" Jane asks.
"No," Ralph says.
"I must keep Cocoa Stream safe from monsters."
The kids take the road up the hill.
Jane shakes. "It's cold!"
Pip tastes the snow.
"Ew." Jane makes a face.
Pip grins. "It's ice cream!"
The kids keep going up the hill.
Jane sighs. "This is a big job.
Can we save Sweet Land on our own?
Ralph had to help us in the boat."
Pip makes a fist. "We can do it!
And we're almost at the top."
The kids take some more steps.
"Phew," Jane says. "We made it."
"I see all of Sweet Land!" Pip says.
Jane groans.
"And there is slime all over the land."
Pip points to the end of the road.
"The castle is a long way away."
"Can we make it there?" Jane asks.
Pip nods. "We have no choice."
Down the hill Pip sees train tracks.
"Maybe we can take the train."
Jane points to slime on the tracks.
"We need to avoid monsters."
Soon the kids come to a big town.
"Where are we?" Pip asks.
Jane reads a sign. "Cookie Town."
Pip peeks in a window. "A toy shop!"
A boy pops up in the window.
"Prince, Princess," he says in a low voice.
"I am Troy. Please come in and hide."
"Why?" Pip asks.
"Monsters are here in Cookie Town," Troy says.
He brings the kids inside. "I have news.
The Gummy Guards are waiting for you.
You must join them at Gummy Grove."
"What will they do?" Jane asks.
"They will keep you safe," Troy says.
"Let's go!" Pip jumps for joy.
"Don't make noise," Troy says.
But it's too late—monsters rush inside!
The monsters drag the kids outside.
They go past cookie houses.
"Help!" Troy cries.
"Monsters have the prince and princess!"
Some people try to help.
The monsters growl and kick them away.
"Let go of us!" Jane cries.
The monsters take the kids out of town.
They drop them on the ground.
"Ouch!" Jane says.
Pip rubs his brow. "Ow!"
A cage pops up. [i@Click!@i]
Pip frowns. "We're locked in here."
Loud shouts ring out. "Let them go!"
The monsters run to the sound.
"Yay!" Jane says. "The people in town!
They got the monsters away."
"How do we get out?" Pip asks.
"I know!" Jane takes out the wand.
She waves it, but nothing happens.
"Let me try," Pip says.
Pip waves the wand too, but nothing happens.
"Give it back," Jane says.
She grabs the wand, but Pip holds on.
The wand shines. [i@Zap!@i]
The cage fades away.
"Wow!" Pip says. "How did that happen?"
"I don't know," Jane says.
"But we need to go, now!"
The kids run away from the town.
"We must join the Gummy Guards," Jane says.
"Troy told us they're at Gummy Grove."
Pip nods. "Where is that?"
Jane thinks of the game map.
She points down the road.
"It's past Brown Sugar Cliffs."
Pip groans. "That's a long way away."
"Can June's wand take us there?" Jane asks.
Pip jumps with joy. "What a good idea!
It got us out of the cage."
Jane waves the wand. "To Gummy Grove!"
Nothing happens.
"Why didn't it work?" Pip says.
"I don't know," Jane says.
The kids come to the cliffs.
Pip plays with the wand.
"Stop that." Jane frowns. "It's not a toy."
Pip drops the wand on the ground.
Jane picks it back up. "I'll keep it."
At Lake Lollipop the road splits in two.
The kids stop by a big rock.
"Which road goes to Gummy Grove?" Pip asks.
"They both do," Jane says.
Just then there is a loud noise.
"Monsters!" Jane says in a low voice. "Hide!"
Jane and Pip look out from the rock.
Big slime monsters slide down the road.
"I think they're looking for us," Pip says.
"Quiet," Jane says.
Soon the monsters are out of sight.
Pip points to the right.
"The monsters took that road to Gummy Grove.
There's a trail of icky goo."
"The left road goes there too," Jane says.
"But it's not as quick."
"Let's go left to be safe," Pip says.
The wide road becomes a thin path.
Soon the kids are in the woods.
Black vines hang, and a cool wind blows.
"I wish I had boots," Pip says.
"The path is squishy!"
"Maybe it's made of food," Jane says.
Pip takes a bite. "It [i@is@i] candy.
But it's not good candy! Yuck!"
"This place is spooky," Jane says.
"I think so too," Pip says.
"I see creepy shadows in the trees."
Jane stops and looks.
Shadows slide quickly in the trees.
"Uh-oh," Jane says. "We're not alone."

episodes.title: Tall Paul and the Gummy Guards

subtitle.text: The shadows walk out of the thick trees.
Pip gulps as they stand around the kids.
A tall, thin man steps out.
"The duke!" Jane thinks. "Stay calm."
"It's them!" the man shouts.
"Hooray!" Loud cries ring out.
"We won't let you win, Duke," Jane says.
The man pauses.
Then he slaps his knee. "Ha-ha! Duke?
I'm not the duke! I'm Tall Paul.
I lead the queen's Gummy Guards."
Pip gasps. "The Gummy Guards?"
Paul rubs his jaw. "Where is June?"
Jane frowns. "June got caught by the duke."
"That's awful," Paul says. "It's not safe here.
We will take you to Gummy Grove."
The kids leave the woods with Paul.
Guards watch for monsters.
"We're glad we found you," Paul says.
"You can stop the duke."
"We have June's wand," Pip says.
"Maybe it will help."
Jane sighs. "It worked only one time.
Can we save Sweet Land without June?"
Paul nods. "That's why you're here.
You're the only ones left who can."
Paul leads the kids to Gummy Grove.
A thick wood wall rings the guards' camp.
"Princess Jane! Prince Pip!"
The guards bow as the kids pass by.
Jane gasps. "There are so many guards."
"Yes," Paul says. "They're here to help you."
Paul walks the kids to a tall tent.
Pip looks at something. "The game map!"
"This is not a game, Prince," Paul says.
"The awful duke put the queen to sleep.
And now he caught June too."
"It's my fault," Jane says quietly.
"We got here too late."
Pip pats Jane on the back.
"We're here now.
We can help."
Just then a guard quickly rushes in.
"Slime is coming into the camp!" he shouts.
Paul rushes out and the kids follow.
Smelly goo flows across the ground.
The guards cannot beat it back.
Paul's jaw drops. "You must act soon.
Or the duke will destroy Sweet Land."
Pip makes a fist. "I'm ready."
Jane nods. "Me too . . . I think."
"Gummy Guards!" Paul shouts. "To the castle!"
Jane and Pip march with the Gummy Guards.
Pip blinks. "Slime is taking over the land!"
"We're not far from the duke," Paul says.
Stinky waves rise and crash into the road.
"Ahh!" Jane screams.
Slime hands reach out for the kids.
Gummy Guards beat the goo away.
At last the army comes to the castle.
"Give up!" a man yells from the gate.
"Sweet Land is sweet no more!
It's Slime Land now—and it's mine!"
Pip darts out.
"Pip!" Jane says. "Don't—"
"You won't win, Duke!" Pip shouts.
The duke grins. "Oh!
It's the short prince and bossy princess!"
Pip yanks the wand from Jane.
He points it at the duke.
"Pip! Stop!" Jane cries.
The duke snorts. "What a bore.
You can't use the wand or sweet magic.
You won't stop me!
You're just two kids who can't get along."
He lifts his arms and sings.
"Stinky goo and icky muck.
Bring those kids to the Duke of Yuck!"
The kids gulp as slime monsters rise up.
Big slime monsters attack.
A slime turtle knocks into the Gummy Guards.
The kids hold on to each other.
"Stay with me," Paul says.
Suddenly slime snakes wrap around Paul!
"Prince, Princess, run!" he cries.
The kids run away from the fighting.
Jane looks at the castle.
"We need to wake the queen.
There's a ladder by that tower."
"We can sneak inside," Pip says.
"That silly duke won't know."
At the doors the duke twirls and sings.
"The boy is rude. The girl is mean.
Now they'll sleep just like the queen!"
Jane nods. "I hope this plan isn't wrong."
The kids sneak to the tower.
They hurry up the ladder.
[i@Bam!@i] A hurt monster crashes into the ladder.
The ladder shakes.
"Ahh!" Jane cries.
"Huh?" The duke looks up. "Get them!"
An ugly slime bird flies at the kids.
They jump in a window as it swoops.
"That was close!" Pip says.
"Come on." Jane grabs Pip's hand.
"We need to find June and the queen!"
The kids check room after room.
They come to the throne room.
"Prince! Princess!" a voice calls from the corner.
"June!" Pip says.
"Are you hurt?" Jane asks.
The sprite lies in a cage.
Knotted ropes are wrapped around her.
"Wake the queen first," June says weakly.
"That will make me better."
The kids turn around.
On the throne they see the snoring queen.
They run to her, but suddenly Pip stops.
"What's that stinky smell?"
Jane sniffs. "I think it's . . ."
The duke bursts in, huffing.
"This castle is far too big," he says.
"It took forever to get up here!
But now I'll stop you!"
Outside a horn blows.
"What now?" The duke runs to a window.
"Urgh! Those Gummy Guards are winning!"
Pip makes a fist. "Good!"
The duke shrugs. "I must go back down.
Until I get back, you're sticking here!"
He raises his arms.
Clouds swirl around the room.
The duke skips out of the throne room.
Then a slime storm starts to rain!
Slime rains down from the stinky clouds.
Pip looks over to June's cage.
"June! Help!" he cries.
But the sprite is fast asleep.
The smelly slime piles up.
It slowly pushes the kids apart.
Jane tries to take a step. "I'm stuck!"
"We need to stop the storm!" Pip says.
"I know that!" Jane snaps.
"Use the wand!" Pip yells.
"Don't tell me what to do!" Jane shouts.
She reaches for June's wand.
She holds it up. "Stop the storm!"
Nothing happens, and the slime keeps rising.
Pip grabs the wand from Jane.
"Hey!" she yells.
"Stop the slime storm!" Pip says.
Jane reaches out.
Pip holds the wand and Jane grabs on.
"Stop the storm!" the two kids cry.
The slime rain stops.
The clouds fade away.
"What happened?" Pip asks.
Jane blinks. "I think the wand worked!"
The kids dash up to the throne.
"Your Majesty," Jane says. "Please wake up."
Pip taps the queen's arm. "Rise and shine!"
But the queen does not stir.
The kids stand by the sleeping queen.
Jane looks at the wand. "We need this.
And I think it only works . . ."
Pip nods. "When we work together."
Jane holds the wand and Pip grabs on.
"Wake the queen!"
A bright flash fills the room.
The queen yawns and stretches her arms.
"Thank you, sweet children," she says.
June zips over, grinning. "Good work!"
Suddenly the duke runs in. "No!
You woke the queen!"
He stomps his way to the throne.
Jane gasps. "The duke!"
"What do we do?" Pip asks.
The queen smiles. "I'll leave that to you."
June points to the wand.
"You two know what to do now."
The kids hold up the wand.
"It's your turn to stick around!" [i@Zap!@i]
Candy ropes wrap around the duke.
Caramel, cream, and chocolate syrup rain on him.
"Ahh!" the duke cries. "I'm stuck!"
"Good work, sweet children," the queen says.
She steps up to the duke.
"Now I must punish you for your crimes."
The queen gives the duke a soft smile.
The duke shakes. "Please let me go.
I will be sweet from now on."
The queen nods. "Yes, you will.
You're not the Duke of Yuck anymore."
The queen snaps her fingers. [i@Zap!@i]
"You're now the Duke of Yum.
And you must clean the mess you made."
Pip grins. "There's a lot to clean!"
June smiles. "Get to work, Duke!"
"Gladly!" the duke says sweetly, bowing.
Sweet Landers gather outside and shout for joy.
"Hooray for the prince and princess!"
"You saved Sweet Land," the queen says.
"You did it by working together.
But it's time for you to go home."
June waves her wand. "Good-bye!" [i@Zap!@i]
The kids are back at Gran's.
Gran comes in the room.
"Whew. Like magic, I'm awake!"
"Gran!" Pip cries. "We saved Sweet Land!"
Jane nods. "And we got along."
Pip pokes Jane.
"Well," Jane says. "We didn't fight [i@too@i] much."
"You're such sweet children." Gran winks.
"Who won the game?"
The kids look at each other.
"We both did."
